changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionCatalogItemProperty') BEGIN create table api.ExecutionCatalogItemProperty ( ExecutionId int not null, [Type] char(1) not null,
TypeSourceId nvarchar(500), TypeId int,
SourceId nvarchar(500) sparse, SubjectSourceId nvarchar(500) sparse, ObjectSourceId nvarchar(500) sparse,
Id bigint, -- The object internal Id (AssetId, IntersectId) Name nvarchar(250), -- The API Name of the field type. FieldTypeId int, [Value] nvarchar(max), -- The raw incoming value. ValueAssetTypeId int, -- Used for lookups. ValueId bigint, -- Used for lookups. CodeValue nvarchar(250) -- Used when the object is a reference list and the property name is Code. Will match based on this. ) END
IF EXISTS ( select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionCatalogItemProperty' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ValueId' ) BEGIN alter table api.ExecutionCatalogItemProperty alter column [ValueId] bigint null; END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'cix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty') BEGIN create clustered index cix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty on api.ExecutionCatalogItemProperty (ExecutionId desc, [Type] asc) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_TypeSourceId') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_TypeSourceId on api.ExecutionCatalogItemProperty (ExecutionId asc, [Type] asc, TypeSourceId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_SourceId') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_SourceId on api.ExecutionCatalogItemProperty (ExecutionId asc, [Type] asc, SourceId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_Id') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_Id on api.ExecutionCatalogItemProperty (Id) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_Name') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_Name on api.ExecutionCatalogItemProperty (Name) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_Id_FieldTypeId') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_Id_FieldTypeId on api.ExecutionCatalogItemProperty (Id, FieldTypeId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_SubjectSourceId_ObjectSourceId') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItemProperty_SubjectSourceId_ObjectSourceId on api.ExecutionCatalogItemProperty (ExecutionId, [Type], SubjectSourceId, ObjectSourceId) END
